scope: Actual raw WebKit PDF operators emit one open axis-aligned m/l/f zero-area fill then independent m/l/S stroke. MuPDF either merges them as fs or retains f and s separately. Only this zero-area fill is excluded; all stroke geometry/color/width/opacity stays checked at original bounds. No polygons, compound paths, closed fs or diagonal fs admitted. Original helper, earlier failures and receipts unchanged.
